findings.title: defaultsDomain() called without required workerIndex argument.
findings.body: `defaultsDomain(workerIndex: number)` requires an argument; calling it with none fails TypeScript compilation, and at runtime yields `com.vellum.vellum-assistant-wundefined`, so the API key is written to the wrong domain. Pass the worker index (e.g. `defaultsDomain(0)` or thread `workerIndex` through). The same applies to line 576.

findings.title: BASE_DATA_DIR override for lockfile location removed.
findings.body: The lockfile path no longer honors BASE_DATA_DIR, so per-instance/isolated data dirs (used by tests and multi-instance setups) now read the home-dir lockfile instead. If intentional, ensure all writers (CLI) also use the home dir; otherwise restore the override.

findings.title: Lockfile contents dumped to CI logs.
findings.body: Printing the first 500 chars of the lockfile to stderr can leak credentials or tokens stored in assistant entries into CI logs. Log only the assistant count/ids instead.
